title: Uruguayan Beef Tacos with Chimichurri Sauce
description: A flavor-packed twist on traditional beef tacos, featuring the bold flavors of Uruguay and a rich, herby chimichurri sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chimichurri sauce ingredients and blend until smooth.
Season the flank steak with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Grill or pan-fry the flank steak to desired level of doneness, then let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly.
Heat the chimichurri sauce in a saucepan over medium-low heat until warm and fragrant.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of the grilled steak onto a warmed tortilla, then spooning some of the chimichurri sauce over the top.
Garnish with sliced red onion, chopped cilantro, and a sprinkle of grated ginger.
